rule_text: Administrators have authorization to create any relationship between two staffs.
Administrators can add approval on patient's insurance.
Nurses cannot associate patients with insurance
Nurses are not allowed to see who owns a clinical protocol
Nurses are not allowed to modify dosage prescribed by staff in a medical document
Admins can add any properties to associations between staff and patient.
Hospital Admins are allowed to unassociate patient from it treatment staff.
Nurses can view the staff which prescribes medical document.
Nurses can view when the staff prescribed a medical document.
